monsters.name: The Body Snatcher
monsters.looksLike: A big, trusted, verified account suddenly posts about free crypto and tags you.
monsters.real: Ireland's police confirmed in October 2026 that two of its official X accounts were accessed by a third party, and warned people not to interact with anything posted on them.
monsters.banish: A blue tick isn't proof. Never connect a wallet from a post you were tagged in.

monsters.name: The Ghost Airdrop
monsters.looksLike: An "official airdrop" from a wallet app or company that has never run one.
monsters.real: Xaman Wallet says it will never DM you, never email you, and never issue a token or an airdrop.
monsters.banish: If the company says it never airdrops, every airdrop in its name is fake.

monsters.name: The Fortune Teller
monsters.looksLike: "Scan your wallet to find unclaimed tokens."
monsters.real: RippleX says Ripple is not running an "XRP Rewards Scanner" or offering unclaimed XRP through a wallet scan, and that screenshots saying otherwise are fake.
monsters.banish: Never let a site "scan" your wallet. Review every transaction before you sign it.

monsters.name: The Doppelgänger
monsters.looksLike: A claim site that looks exactly like the real one, on an address that's slightly off.
monsters.real: When its PNT claim opened, Pheasant Network warned that fake websites had been discovered and asked users to verify the website link.
monsters.banish: Type the claim domain yourself, letter by letter. Use our claim-link checker, and remember "not in our list" never means safe.

monsters.name: The Swarm
monsters.looksLike: Replies under a real launch post, full of "claim here" links.
monsters.real: Jumper warned of large amounts of scam links around its sale and told people to use only the official platform.
monsters.banish: Links in replies and DMs are never the official link. Go to the project's own site.

monsters.name: The Mimic
monsters.looksLike: A "collection" or token that appears before the project has announced anything.
monsters.real: MINT warned that fake collections were already popping up on OpenSea, and said it will announce official mint details clearly and never stealth launch.
monsters.banish: If the project hasn't announced it on its official channels, it isn't real yet.

monsters.name: The Soul Collector
monsters.looksLike: Any page or "support agent" that asks for your seed phrase or private key.
monsters.real: Grass tells users to never share a seed phrase or private key with anyone, and to download only from grass.io.
monsters.banish: Nobody legitimate ever needs your seed phrase. Close the page.
